notes.title: Live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p]We are so thrilled to announce Fallen Fates is now [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates" style="button" buttoncolor="#568656"]live on Kickstarter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The big day is here 🥰[/p][p]We put all our heart in this campaign and we hope you’ll feel it too!![/p][p][/p][p]We tried to put as many details about the game as we could and we took much pleasure to do so![/p][p][/p][h2]New Trailer[/h2][p]For the occasion we prepared a 2 minutes long trailer including traditional cinematics made by[b] Sapin Sympa collective[/b]. It will also feature a lot of new in-game content to depict better what the game aims to look like.[/p][previewyoutube="SzmrRiz65cc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And…this trailer is voiced! We didn’t announce it much yet but[b] Ben Starr[/b] will be voicing Arven!!![/p][p]We’re thrilled to have him on board and his voice gives so much depth and life to Arven, we love it! 😄
[/p][h2]Six One Indie showcase[/h2][p]In addition to the Kickstarter trailer, we’ll be live at Six One Indie showcase with another trailer! [/p][p]Showcase will be aired at 6PM CEST: [/p][h2][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QncfsZr_fxQ"][/dynamiclink]Early Birds[/h2][p]We said in our previous [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates/posts/4487241"][u]newsletter[/u][/url] that your support was important, and early backers have a huge impact on a Kickstarter success too.[/p][p]That’s why you’ll find 3 Early Birds tiers:[/p][list][*][p]2 of them are a discount on a digital tiers and a physical tiers[/p][/*][*][p]The 3rd one is a premium tiers in which you’ll also have [b]a figure of Ayla’s from Astral Ascent for the same price.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have planned many amazing digital and physical rewards![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/9d5acb62992029ed6765a0516d13a140d0464681.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being around from the start of this exciting new journey and we hope you will love this game we are crafting as much as we do!

- The Hibernian Workshop Team[/p]

notes.title: Fallen Fates Kickstarter is landing on September 18th!
notes.notes:
[p]Quick update just to let everyone know [b]Fallen Fates Kickstarter[/b] will be live on [b]September 18th[/b] at 5pm CEST / 8AM PDT / 11AM EDT! 

Here is below a new trailer to announce the Kickstarter trailer and showing more of the game![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2urYrEuC3wc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You can expect to learn a loooot more about Fallen Fates, get exclusive rewards and so much more! [/p][p]Kickstarter pre-launch page is live, make sure you [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates?ref=20o9xk" style="button" buttoncolor="#31813a"]follow the page[/url] so you'll be notified when we go live, show your interest and help the community reach social goals![/p][p]
We’ll also have a special bonus gift for Discord members 💖[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/5Jar7GbVP4"]Join the community here[/url] to get familiar with the game and connect with others[/p][p][/p][p]- The Hibernian Workshop team[/p]

notes.title: Fallen Fates at the MIX Fall Game Showcase
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We hope you had a nice summer 😊[/p][p][/p][p]On our side we’ve been working hard on the [b]2.2 update[/b] of our previous game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280930/Astral_Ascent/"]Astral Ascent[/url].[/p][p]But don’t worry, our continued support for [i]Astral Ascent[/i] hasn’t slowed down progress on [i][b]Fallen Fates[/b][/i]! The team has been making great progress in its development![/p][p][/p][h1][b]MIX Fall Game Showcase[/b][/h1][p]We’re excited to share that Fallen Fates will be showcased on August 29th during the [b]MIX Fall Games Showcase[/b] at [i]9AM PST / 6PM CEST[/i].[/p][p]📺Twitch: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/mediaindieexchange"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p]📺 Youtube: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/c/MediaIndieExchange"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]During the event, you’ll get to see our brand-new trailer, featuring the [b]Kickstarter date announcement[/b], along with fresh gameplay footage, new music, and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/a301380904630f60e140fc51e94031c5276e48ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We can’t wait for you to watch it. We’ve had a lot of fun creating it and we hope you’ll feel that too. 😀[/p][p]
[/p][p]- The Hibernian Workshop team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Fallen Fates devlog #1 - July 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, and welcome to the first Fallen Fates devlog![/p][p]We don’t know at which frequency we will make those ones but in any case we aim to share you more about the game we are making as we loved the relationship we had with the community on Astral Ascent and we wish to have the same relationship with you on this new project![/p][p]Don’t hesitate to follow us on [u][url="https://x.com/HibernianWS"]X[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/hibernianws.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/u], as we will share a lot there too![/p][p]
[/p][p]In this devlog you’ll find a mix of what has been happening this month on Fallen Fates:[/p][list][*][p]Kickstarter campaign is cooking[/p][/*][*][p]New trailer in the work[/p][/*][*][p]Concept art for monsters[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Kickstarter campaign will land on September [/h2][p]If you followed our journey on Astral Ascent (and maybe Dark Devotion too), you know that Kickstarter is something we love at the studio.[/p][p]Not only for the financial aid it can provide to indie studios, but also [b]for the link it creates with the community[/b]. Having people super invested in the game you’re working on with your heart is extremely powerful and motivating.[/p][p]We saw it on[b] Astral Ascent[/b], the continuous support from the community helped a lot to bring the game on another level. It’s something we want to keep during the development of [b]Fallen Fates.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/7b25266eea13b85bae4fab9db3b4242e347fe9ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Along with the production of Fallen Fates, the team is also getting ready for the Kickstarter launch. We prepared many surprises for you along with a lot of goodies for backers!  If you want to help the campaign, you can follow the pre-launch page on Kickstarter: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hibernian-workshop/fallen-fates[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2]Next Trailer[/h2][p]Back at the end of May, we shared the announcement trailer for [b]Fallen Fates[/b] during the [b]AG French Direct event[/b]. It was very well received, bringing [b]Fallen Fates[/b] to [b]15,000 wishlists[/b] in just two months, thank you so much![/p][p]To showcase more of the game and the direction we're aiming for, we're currently working on another trailer. It will feature more in-game content, along with a brand-new cinematic. [/p][p]For the latter, we collaborated with [i][u][url="https://www.instagram.com/collectif.sapin.sympa/?hl=fr"]Sapin Sympa[/url][/u][/i] (a French animation collective) to create the cinematic in a traditional animated style. For the occasion, Sapin Sympa brought together a team of animators who have worked on many film and commercial projects, including for clients such as Riot, Blizzard, Disney, and many others. The collaboration went very well and the result is amazing! We can’t wait to share you the whole trailer.[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to share 2 sneak peeks of the trailer with you:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/ba9df903a0c6ddb34e9e8f4d55d9d569d98c59ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you already saw on the trailer, our main character Arven is not alone in his journey. He is always accompanied by Kat, a powerful creature. Who is she? What are her powers? How did she end up accompanying Arven? You’ll learn more in the next trailer and during the Kickstarter.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/c940332d129cb371c7abbce61d7d3d5ca4af5e3f.png"][/img][i]In-game content progress | WIP[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the animated cinematic, we are also going to reveal more in-game content. What we shared so far was during dawn, but you’ll also be able to explore Tellus during the day.
What is Arven doing in this scene? You’ll discover it in the trailer too![/p][p][/p][h2]Concept arts of monsters[/h2][p][b]Fallen Fates[/b] is a 2D action-RPG, so monsters will play a major role in the game. As your journey takes you across the vast world of Tellus, you’ll encounter many powerful and unique enemies of various types.[/p][p]The main threat is known as the “[b]Shadows[/b]”. Emerging from the falling crystals, they often appear to be part of their surroundings, as if they’ve adapted to their environment in order to survive. As crystals have been falling for over a thousand years now, we are not talking about a few monsters but a real colony…[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some researches we’ve done on Shadows recently:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/a9dc98fe9c401d96fc0f83dc848ea88018b01c14.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637285/983974e39dd3331915d760ce19bc9f601688fa53.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And that’s all for this first devlog ✨[/p][p]Don’t hesitate to tell us in the comments what kind of subjects you would like us to talk about.
You can also join the community on [u][url="https://discord.gg/hibernian-workshop"]Discord[/url][/u] to talk about the game.[/p][p]Again, thank you for your support![/p][p]Cheers[/p][p][/p][p]- The Hibernian Workshop team.[/p][p]
[/p]
